integrity: The analytic proof establishes the result for every polygon with at least three vertices and every positive real exponent, including compact-uniform convergence in the critical window. Finite computations are corroboration only. Publication priority and independent mathematical review are not certified.
limitations: Applies to area-uniform random points and polygon-vertex sites in unit-circumradius regular polygons. The finite-order moment integral follows in principle from existing general triangle-moment methods; the asserted novelty concerns the explicit three-regime and varying-exponent asymptotics. Nothing is claimed for irregular polygons or unbounded exponent windows.
title: A critical-moment crossover for nearest-vertex distances in regular polygons
